paragraphs: Notenetic sells an electronic health record system for behavioral health practices, with the site saying the product covers intake through billing. The pages describe it as covering clients, clinicians and staff, documentation, billing and reconciliation in one system. Documentation can use default templates or fields customized to a practice through a template builder, and the pages say elements can be enhanced with AI.

Telehealth is listed as integrated video sessions described as HIPAA compliant. Insurance billing covers electronic claim submission to payers, with reconciliation so an agency can track where a claim stands. A Client Portal is listed as a centralized location for communication and for signing documentation.

The pages name community behavioral health agencies as one group of users, and say Notenetic helps an agency with billing Medicaid, Medicare and other private payers. Solo and group practices are also named, along with mental health professionals, clinicians, social and case workers, substance use counselors and therapists. Subscriptions carry no long term contract and can be cancelled or modified at any time, according to the questions section of the site.

quote.text: Finally, an EHR built for Behavioral Health that actually works with you.
